managing Direct Debits, including mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation

compliance with Direct Debit Scheme rules

name: Direct Debit Mandate Collection and Setup
description: Initial step in the Direct Debit process where mandate details are collected from the customer and the Direct Debit arrangement is formally established on the account.
context: Direct Debit mandate collection and setup

name: Direct Debit Processing and Execution
description: Operational step where Direct Debit payments are processed and executed according to the mandate terms and customer instructions.

name: Failed Direct Debit Handling
description: Step addressing the handling and resolution of Direct Debit payments that fail to process successfully, including investigation and remediation actions.

name: Customer Disputes and Claims

name: Direct Debit Cancellation

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The Direct Debit mandate established between the bank and customer, governing the collection and processing of Direct Debit payments from the customer's account.

name: Standing Order
description: A payment instruction initiated by the customer with a fixed amount paid at regular intervals. The customer instructs the bank directly on what to pay, and cancellation can be made anytime with immediate effect.
context: You tell bank what to pay

name: Direct Debit
description: A payment instruction initiated by the biller or company where the amount can vary (e.g., utility bills). The biller sends payment instructions to the bank and the customer receives full Direct Debit Guarantee protection. Cancellation typically requires 5-day notice.

name: Direct Debit Guarantee
description: Full protection provided to customers using Direct Debit as a payment method, distinguishing it from the limited protection available with Standing Orders.
context: Protection | Limited | Full Direct Debit Guarantee

name: Customer
description: The account holder who initiates Standing Orders and receives Direct Debit Guarantee protection. The customer has control over Standing Order setup and cancellation.
context: You tell bank what to pay

name: Direct Debit Setup and Payment Processing
description: End-to-end process for establishing a direct debit mandate and processing recurring payments. Begins with biller authorization request, proceeds through customer mandate signing and system setup, and culminates in automated payment processing with customer dispute/cancellation rights.

name: Biller Authorization Request
description: Initial step where the biller formally requests authorization to set up a direct debit arrangement with the customer.

name: Customer Direct Debit Mandate Signing
description: Customer executes the direct debit mandate document, providing legal consent for the biller to collect payments via direct debit.

name: Mandate System Recording
description: The signed direct debit mandate is recorded and activated in the banking system to enable automated payment processing.

name: Biller Payment Instruction Submission
description: Biller submits the payment instruction to the bank, specifying the amount and timing for the direct debit collection.

name: Automated Payment Processing
description: The banking system automatically processes the direct debit payment from the customer's account based on the biller's instruction.

name: Payment Completion Confirmation
description: Confirmation that the direct debit payment has been successfully processed and completed.

name: Customer Dispute and Cancellation Rights
description: Customer retains the right to dispute individual payments or cancel the direct debit mandate at any time during or after the process.

name: Biller
description: External party that requests authorization and submits payment instructions to collect funds via direct debit from the customer's account.

name: Customer
description: Account holder who signs the direct debit mandate, authorizes payments, and retains rights to dispute or cancel the arrangement.

name: Banking System
description: Automated banking system responsible for recording the mandate and processing direct debit payments according to biller instructions.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Legal authorization document signed by the customer that permits the biller to collect recurring payments via direct debit from the customer's account.

name: Direct Debit Customer
description: Natural person who holds the account subject to the direct debit arrangement and retains dispute and cancellation rights.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Collection Process
description: The end-to-end procedure for collecting Direct Debit mandates from customers who wish to authorize recurring payments to billers. The process begins when a customer agrees to pay by Direct Debit and signs a mandate form containing bank account details, biller information, and authorization.
context: Customer signs up for utility bill, gym membership, insurance, etc.
Biller asks: 'Can we take payment by Direct Debit?'
Customer agrees and signs mandate form
Mandate Form Contains: Bank account details (account number, sort code), Biller details (name, DDIC number), Amount type (fixed or variable), Customer authorization (signature)

name: Mandate Initiation
description: The initial stage where a customer agrees to authorize Direct Debit payments and signs the mandate form. This step captures the customer's consent and collects all required mandate information.
context: Customer signs up for utility bill, gym membership, insurance, etc.
Biller asks: 'Can we take payment by Direct Debit?'
Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: A signed authorization form that enables a biller to collect recurring payments from a customer's bank account. The mandate contains bank account details, biller identification, payment amount type, and customer signature.
context: Customer agrees and signs mandate form
Mandate Form Contains: Bank account details (account number, sort code), Biller details (name, DDIC number), Amount type (fixed or variable), Customer authorization (signature)

name: Customer
description: The individual who authorizes Direct Debit payments by signing a mandate form. The customer agrees to allow a biller to collect recurring payments from their bank account.
context: Customer signs up for utility bill, gym membership, insurance, etc.
Biller asks: 'Can we take payment by Direct Debit?'
Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: Bank Account Details
description: The customer's bank account information collected on the Direct Debit mandate form, including account number and sort code. These details enable the biller to identify and access the correct account for payment collection.
context: Mandate Form Contains: Bank account details (account number, sort code)

name: Biller Details
description: The biller's identification information recorded on the Direct Debit mandate, including the biller's name and DDIC (Direct Debit Information Centre) number. This identifies the organization authorized to collect payments.
context: Mandate Form Contains: Biller details (name, DDIC number)

name: Customer Authorization Signature
description: The customer's signature on the Direct Debit mandate form that provides legal authorization for the biller to collect recurring payments. This signature evidences the customer's consent to the mandate.
context: Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: Customer Bank Account
description: The customer's bank account from which Direct Debit payments are authorized to be collected. The account is identified by account number and sort code on the mandate form.
context: Mandate Form Contains: Bank account details (account number, sort code)

name: Direct Debit Mandate Setup
description: End-to-end procedure for receiving, verifying, and recording a direct debit mandate when it reaches FirstUK Bank from a biller or customer. The process includes account validation, customer identity confirmation, system recording, biller notification via ARUDD message, and customer confirmation.
context: Mandate received from biller or customer

name: Mandate Receipt
description: Initial step where the direct debit mandate is received by FirstUK Bank, either directly from the biller or from the customer.
context: Mandate received from biller or customer

name: Account Details Verification
description: Verification step to confirm that the account details provided in the mandate are in valid format and that the account exists in FirstUK's system.

name: Customer Identity Confirmation
description: Step to confirm the identity of the customer associated with the mandate before proceeding with mandate recording.

name: Mandate System Recording
description: Step where the verified mandate details are recorded in FirstUK's system for ongoing management and reference.

name: Biller Notification
description: Step where the biller is notified of successful mandate setup via an ARUDD (Automated Return of Unpaid Direct Debit) message, confirming the mandate is active.

name: Customer Confirmation
description: Final step where the customer receives confirmation that their direct debit mandate has been successfully set up.

name: FirstUK Bank Operations Staff
description: FirstUK Bank's operational team responsible for receiving, verifying, recording, and notifying parties of direct debit mandate setup.

name: Biller
description: External party that either sends the mandate to FirstUK Bank or receives notification of mandate setup via ARUDD message.
context: Mandate received from biller or customer

name: Customer
description: The customer who signs the direct debit mandate and may send it to FirstUK Bank, or receives confirmation of mandate setup.

customer signs it and biller sends it to us

description: A direct debit mandate received by FirstUK Bank from a biller or customer, which authorizes recurring payments from a customer's account. The mandate is signed by the customer and sent to FirstUK for recording and activation.

customer signs it and biller sends it to us

description: A natural person who signs a direct debit mandate authorizing FirstUK Bank to process recurring payments on their account.
context: customer signs it and biller sends it to us

name: Customer Account
description: A customer's account held at FirstUK Bank against which a direct debit mandate is set up. The account details must be verified for valid format and existence before the mandate can be recorded.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Setup
description: The operational procedure for recording and activating a direct debit mandate in the banking system. This process captures all mandate details including customer account, biller information, payment terms, and mandate status upon system entry.

name: System Entry of Mandate Details
description: The discrete step of entering and recording all mandate fields into the banking system, including mandate reference, customer account, biller details, payment terms, and activation status.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: A direct debit mandate established with reference 12345678-1 for variable payments to Electricity Co Ltd with unlimited maximum amount, effective from 2026-02-01 with Active status.

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account ACC-00001 against which the direct debit mandate is established and recorded in the system.

name: Primary Account Holder
description: The primary holder of account ACC-00001 who is the subject of the direct debit mandate setup and system recording.

name: Mandate Validation Process
description: A validation workflow that verifies direct debit mandate eligibility before processing. The process checks account status, account holder identity, biller registration, mandate authorization, and duplicate mandate prevention. If any validation fails, the mandate is returned to the sender with a request for correction.
context: No duplicate mandates for same biller

name: Account Existence and Status Check
description: Verification step that confirms the customer account exists in the system and is in an active state, eligible to receive direct debit mandates.

name: Account Holder Identity Verification
description: Verification step that confirms the account holder named on the mandate matches the account holder on record in the system.

name: Biller Registration Validation
description: Verification step that confirms the biller's Direct Debit Information Code (DDIC) is valid and the biller is registered in the system.

name: Mandate Authorization Verification
description: Verification step that confirms the mandate form has been properly signed and authorized by the account holder in accordance with mandate requirements.

name: Duplicate Mandate Check
aliases: No duplicate mandates for same biller
description: Verification step that confirms no existing mandate is already in place for the same biller on this account, preventing duplicate payment instructions.
context: No duplicate mandates for same biller

name: Mandate Return and Correction Request
description: Failure handling step that returns the mandate to the sender and requests a corrected version when validation fails.

name: Mandate Validation Pass/Fail Gate
description: A branching decision point that determines whether all mandate validation checks have passed. If validation passes, the mandate proceeds to processing. If validation fails, the mandate is returned to the sender for correction.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: A direct debit payment instruction subject to validation checks including account verification, account holder matching, biller registration, authorization confirmation, and duplicate prevention before processing.
context: No duplicate mandates for same biller

name: Customer Account
description: A customer account that must be active and verified to match the account holder on a direct debit mandate before the mandate can be processed.

name: Account Holder
description: The primary account holder whose identity must match the mandate and whose authorization signature must be verified on the mandate form.

name: Payment Processing
description: End-to-end process for submitting and executing direct debit payment instructions from a biller through FirstUK. Encompasses biller submission, mandate validation, account debiting, and notification of payment outcome.
context: Submits instruction via Direct Debit scheme

name: Biller Amount Determination
description: Biller calculates and determines the payment amount due from the customer, such as monthly utility charges.
context: Biller determines amount due (e.g., £75 for monthly electricity)

name: Payment Instruction Submission
description: Biller submits the payment instruction through the Direct Debit scheme to initiate the payment process.
context: Submits instruction via Direct Debit scheme

name: Payment Instruction Reception
description: FirstUK receives the payment instruction from the biller via the Direct Debit scheme.

name: Mandate Validation
description: FirstUK validates the payment instruction against the active direct debit mandate, confirming that the amount is within agreed limits and the account is active.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Account Debit
description: FirstUK debits the validated payment amount from the customer's account.

name: Payment Outcome Notification
description: Biller is notified of the payment processing outcome, indicating whether the payment succeeded or failed.

name: Biller
description: External party responsible for submitting payment instructions and receiving payment outcome notifications. Determines the amount due and initiates the direct debit submission.
context: Submits instruction via Direct Debit scheme

name: FirstUK
description: The bank's payment processing system responsible for receiving payment instructions, validating against mandates, debiting customer accounts, and notifying billers of outcomes.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The active direct debit authorization against which payment instructions are validated. Defines amount limits and account status requirements for payment processing.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Customer Account
description: The customer's account from which direct debit payments are debited. Must be active and have a valid mandate in place for payment processing.

name: Mandate Validation Gate
description: Decision point where FirstUK validates the payment instruction against the mandate. Determines whether the amount is within limits and the account is active, leading to either payment debit or failure notification.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Direct Debit Processing
description: End-to-end process for validating and executing direct debit transactions against customer accounts. Includes pre-debit validation checks (mandate status, amount limits, fund availability, timing) and failure handling with biller notification and potential customer charges.
context: Validation Before Debit: Mandate active (not canceled), Amount doesn't exceed maximum (if set), Account has sufficient funds, Instruction received in time window
If Any Check Fails: Debit rejected, Biller notified (with reason), Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: Mandate Active Validation
description: Verification step that confirms the direct debit mandate is active and has not been canceled before processing the debit instruction.

name: Amount Limit Validation
description: Verification step that confirms the debit amount does not exceed any maximum limit set on the mandate.

name: Funds Availability Check
description: Verification step that confirms the customer account has sufficient funds available to cover the debit amount.

name: Instruction Timing Validation
description: Verification step that confirms the debit instruction was received within the required time window for processing.

name: Debit Rejection
description: Action taken when any validation check fails, resulting in the debit being rejected and not processed against the customer account.

name: Biller Notification
description: Notification step where the biller is informed of the debit rejection and provided with the reason for the failure.

name: Customer Charge Assessment
description: Step where it is determined whether the customer will be charged a fee for the failed debit attempt, with the outcome varying by biller policy.
context: Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: All Validation Checks Pass
description: Decision gate that determines whether all four pre-debit validation checks (mandate active, amount limit, funds availability, timing) have passed. If any check fails, the debit is rejected.
context: Validation Before Debit: Mandate active (not canceled), Amount doesn't exceed maximum (if set), Account has sufficient funds, Instruction received in time window
If Any Check Fails: Debit rejected

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The direct debit authorization that must be active and valid for debit processing. The mandate can be canceled, which triggers rejection of subsequent debit attempts.

name: Biller
description: The external party receiving the direct debit payment who is notified when a debit is rejected, including the reason for failure.
context: Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: Debit Processing System
description: The automated system responsible for executing the validation checks and determining whether to process or reject the debit instruction.
context: If Any Check Fails: Debit rejected

name: Customer
description: The account holder whose account is subject to direct debit validation and who may incur charges if a debit attempt fails.
context: Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account against which direct debit validation is performed, including checks for mandate status, fund availability, and amount limits.

name: Direct Debit Submission and Settlement Process
description: End-to-end process for direct debit submission by billers, overnight processing by FirstUK via BACS, and settlement of funds to billers. The process operates on a defined timeline with submission 3 days before payment date, overnight processing, and next business day settlement.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

name: Biller Submission
description: Billers submit direct debit instructions 3 days prior to the scheduled payment date. This step initiates the direct debit processing cycle.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date

name: Overnight BACS Processing
description: FirstUK processes all submitted direct debit instructions overnight using the BACS (Bankers' Automated Clearing Services) system. This automated step handles the clearing and settlement preparation.

name: Settlement to Biller
description: Processed funds are settled and reach the biller's account on the next business day following overnight processing. This completes the direct debit cycle.
context: Funds reach biller next business day

name: Biller
description: External organization that submits direct debit instructions to FirstUK and receives settlement of funds. Billers initiate the process by submitting payment instructions 3 days before the payment date.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

name: FirstUK Processing System
description: Automated system responsible for receiving biller submissions, processing direct debit instructions overnight via BACS, and orchestrating settlement to billers. Acts as the central clearing and settlement engine.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Direct debit instructions submitted by billers to FirstUK for processing. These mandates are submitted 3 days before the payment date and processed overnight for next business day settlement.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

name: Failed Direct Debit Handling
description: Operational procedure for managing direct debit payment failures on customer accounts. Covers scenarios where direct debits cannot be processed due to account status, insufficient funds, or mandate issues. The process identifies failure reasons and determines appropriate remediation actions.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled

name: Failure Reason Identification
description: Diagnostic step to determine the root cause of a direct debit failure. Evaluates whether the failure is due to account closure, insufficient funds, account freeze, or mandate cancellation.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled (customer didn't inform biller)

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Standing direct debit instruction on a customer account subject to failure scenarios including mandate cancellation when the customer fails to notify the biller of the cancellation.

name: Customer Account
description: Customer account subject to direct debit processing and potential failure states including closure, freeze, or insufficient funds conditions.

name: Direct Debit Failure Reason Gate
description: Branching decision point that categorizes the direct debit failure into one of four scenarios: account closure, insufficient funds, account freeze, or mandate cancellation. Each path leads to different remediation handling.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled (customer didn't inform biller)

name: Direct Debit Failure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for handling failed direct debit payment attempts, including system blocking, notification to biller and customer, and retry options. The process captures the sequence from initial payment failure through customer remediation and optional biller retry.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Debit Attempt Failure Recording
description: System blocks the payment attempt and records the failure with the reason code (e.g., insufficient funds, closed account). This is the initial detection and logging step in the failure workflow.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Biller Notification
description: Automated ARUDD rejection message is sent to the biller, including the reason code for the payment failure. This notifies the creditor of the failed collection attempt.

name: Customer Notification
description: Optional email or SMS alert is sent to the customer (if opted in), containing the payment amount, biller name, and failure reason. This informs the customer of the failed direct debit attempt.

name: Customer Remediation Action
description: Customer takes one of three actions in response to the failure: provide sufficient funds to the account, contact the biller to arrange alternative payment, or cancel the Direct Debit mandate. This step represents the customer's required response.
context: Contact biller to arrange alternative payment, OR

name: Biller Retry Attempt
description: Biller may elect to retry the payment collection, typically within 3–5 days of the initial failure. The retry typically succeeds if sufficient funds are now available in the customer's account.
context: Retry typically succeeds if funds now available

name: Payment Processing System
description: Automated system responsible for blocking failed payment attempts and recording the failure reason. It executes the initial detection and logging of direct debit failures.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Automated Notification Engine
description: Automated system responsible for sending ARUDD rejection messages to billers and optional email/SMS alerts to customers. It delivers failure notifications with reason codes and payment details.

name: Biller
description: External party receiving the ARUDD rejection notification and holding the option to retry the payment collection within 3–5 days. The biller decides whether to attempt re-collection.

name: Customer
description: Account holder who receives the failure notification and must take remedial action: provide funds, contact the biller, or cancel the Direct Debit. The customer is the primary actor in resolving the failure.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Standing direct debit instruction on a customer account that is subject to failure and retry procedures. The mandate can be cancelled by the customer in response to repeated failures.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Failed Direct Debit Payment
description: A direct debit payment attempt that is blocked by the system due to insufficient funds, closed account, or other reasons. The failure is recorded with a reason code and triggers notifications to both biller and customer.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Direct Debit Dispute
description: Customer-initiated dispute process for unauthorized, incorrect, or erroneous direct debit charges. Covered under the Direct Debit Guarantee with mandatory bank refund within 10 business days, no questions asked, and no customer liability.
context: If Unauthorized Debit: Customer files claim with FirstUK
FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: Direct Debit Guarantee
description: Mandatory consumer protection scheme that guarantees refund of unauthorized, incorrect, or erroneous direct debit charges within 10 business days with no questions asked and no liability to the customer.
context: Full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee
FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: FirstUK
description: The bank responsible for processing direct debit disputes, investigating claims, and issuing refunds to customers within the 10 business day service level under the Direct Debit Guarantee.
context: FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: Customer
description: The account holder who initiates a direct debit dispute claim when an unauthorized, incorrect, or erroneous charge appears on their account.
context: Customer contacts bank: 'I didn't authorize this!'

name: Direct Debit Dispute Resolution
description: The operational step where FirstUK receives, processes, and resolves customer claims for unauthorized, incorrect, or erroneous direct debit charges, issuing refunds within 10 business days.
context: FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: Unauthorized Debit Investigation
description: Investigation step triggered when a customer reports an unauthorized direct debit charge, resulting in immediate refund under the Direct Debit Guarantee.
context: Customer contacts bank: 'I didn't authorize this!'
Full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee

name: Incorrect Amount Verification
description: Verification step to confirm whether the charged amount matches the authorized amount, with refund of any overage within 10 business days.

name: Post-Cancellation Charge Review
description: Review step to verify whether a direct debit charge was incorrectly applied after the customer canceled the mandate, with refund of the erroneous charge within 10 business days.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Cancellation
description: The process by which a customer terminates a direct debit mandate, after which no further charges should be applied by the biller.

name: Fraudulent Debit
description: A direct debit charge applied without customer authorization, triggering a fraud claim and immediate refund under the Direct Debit Guarantee.
context: Customer contacts bank: 'I didn't authorize this!'
Full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee

name: Claim Process
description: End-to-end procedure for customers to report Direct Debit issues and receive resolution. The process spans from initial issue reporting through investigation, decision, and refund execution. Includes multiple contact channels (phone, email, branch) and a defined 10-day refund timeline for approved claims.

name: Customer Reports Issue
description: Initial step where customer reports a Direct Debit problem through one of three available channels: phone, email, or in-person branch visit. This step captures the customer's complaint and initiates the claim process.

name: FirstUK Investigates
description: Investigation step where FirstUK verifies Direct Debit mandate details, confirms mandate status (active or canceled), contacts the biller if necessary, and assesses the overall validity of the customer's claim.

name: Decision
description: Decision point where the claim is either approved or denied. Approved claims proceed to refund processing within 10 days; denied claims receive an explanation to the customer.

name: Refund
description: Final step where approved refund funds are credited to the customer's account and a confirmation notification is sent to the customer.

name: Claim Approval or Denial
description: Branching decision point following investigation where the claim is either approved (leading to refund processing within 10 days) or denied (leading to explanation provided to customer).

name: Customer Service Representative
description: FirstUK staff member responsible for receiving customer issue reports via phone, email, or branch visit, and for conducting the investigation into Direct Debit claim validity.

name: FirstUK Investigator
description: FirstUK operational role responsible for verifying Direct Debit mandate details, confirming mandate status, contacting billers, and assessing claim validity during the investigation phase.

name: Claim Decision Maker
description: FirstUK role responsible for making the final approval or denial decision on a Direct Debit claim based on investigation findings.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Direct Debit mandate on a customer account that is subject to investigation during the claim process. The mandate status (active or canceled) is verified as part of claim assessment.

name: Customer
description: Individual customer who reports a Direct Debit issue and initiates the claim process. The customer receives investigation outcome notification and, if approved, a refund confirmation.

name: Dispute Resolution Process
description: A three-tier escalation procedure for customers who disagree with FirstUK's decision. The process begins with manager escalation, proceeds to formal complaint handling, and may ultimately be referred to the Financial Ombudsman Service if the dispute remains unresolved.
context: If customer unhappy with FirstUK's decision

name: Manager Escalation
description: The initial escalation step where a customer dispute is raised to a manager for review and resolution.

name: Formal Complaint Process
description: The formal complaint handling procedure invoked when a customer remains dissatisfied after manager escalation, governed by FirstUK's complaints policy.

name: Financial Ombudsman Service Referral
description: The final escalation step where an unresolved dispute is referred to the Financial Ombudsman Service for independent adjudication.

name: Manager (Dispute Resolution)
description: The manager responsible for receiving and reviewing customer disputes escalated from the initial decision, serving as the first escalation point in the dispute resolution process.

name: Financial Ombudsman Service
description: An independent external authority that adjudicates unresolved customer disputes against FirstUK when internal escalation and formal complaint procedures have not achieved resolution.

name: Customer Satisfaction with FirstUK Decision
description: A branching decision point determining whether the customer accepts FirstUK's decision or escalates the dispute. If the customer is unhappy, the dispute enters the escalation procedure.
context: If customer unhappy with FirstUK's decision

name: Resolution After Formal Complaint
description: A branching decision point determining whether the formal complaint process resolves the dispute or whether further escalation to the Financial Ombudsman Service is required.

name: Dissatisfied Customer
description: A customer who disagrees with FirstUK's decision and initiates the dispute resolution process through escalation.
context: If customer unhappy with FirstUK's decision

name: Direct Debit Mandate Cancellation
description: The process by which a customer can cancel an active direct debit mandate with FirstUK Bank. The customer may initiate cancellation through multiple channels: direct contact with the bank via phone, email, branch visit, or online form submission, or alternatively by requesting the biller to cease collection.
context: Contact FirstUK Bank - Phone: 0800-555-2265, Email: support@firstuk.bank, Branch: Visit in person, Online: Submit cancellation form
Contact Biller - Ask biller to cease collection, Biller may notify FirstUK automatically

name: Customer-Initiated Cancellation via FirstUK Bank
description: The step where a customer contacts FirstUK Bank directly to request cancellation of a direct debit mandate through one of four available channels: telephone, email, in-person branch visit, or online form submission.

name: Biller-Initiated Cancellation Request
description: The step where a customer requests the biller to cease collection, with the biller potentially notifying FirstUK Bank automatically to effect the mandate cancellation.

name: FirstUK Bank Customer Service
description: The FirstUK Bank team responsible for receiving and processing direct debit mandate cancellation requests from customers via phone, email, branch, or online channels.

name: Biller
description: The external organization collecting payments via direct debit, which may receive a cancellation request from the customer and can notify FirstUK Bank to cease collection.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: An active direct debit mandate that a customer seeks to cancel through FirstUK Bank or by requesting the biller to cease collection. The cancellation process provides multiple contact methods to effect the termination.

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds an active direct debit mandate and wishes to cancel it. The customer may initiate cancellation through multiple channels provided by FirstUK Bank or through the biller.

name: Direct Debit Cancellation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for cancelling a direct debit mandate with immediate effect. Includes customer identity verification, mandate status update, biller notification via ARUDD, customer confirmation, and blocking of future payments. Pending payments are blocked if cancellation occurs before settlement date.
context: Upon Cancellation Request: 1. Verify customer identity 2. Confirm mandate details 3. Set mandate status to "Canceled" 4. Notify biller (automated ARUDD cancellation) 5. Send confirmation to customer 6. Future payments blocked
Effective Date: Immediate (no notice period required)
Any Pending Payments: Blocked if cancellation before settlement date

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: Initial step in the cancellation process where the customer's identity is verified before proceeding with mandate cancellation.

name: Mandate Details Confirmation
description: Step to confirm and validate the specific mandate details being cancelled, ensuring the correct mandate is identified.

name: Mandate Status Update
description: System step to update the mandate status to 'Canceled' in the banking system, formally recording the cancellation.

name: Biller Notification via ARUDD
description: Automated step to notify the biller of the mandate cancellation using the ARUDD (Automated Return of Unpaid Direct Debit) system.

name: Customer Cancellation Confirmation
description: Step to send formal confirmation to the customer that their direct debit mandate has been successfully cancelled.

name: Future Payments Block
description: System step to block all future payments under the cancelled mandate, preventing any further debits from being processed.

name: Operations Staff - Cancellation Handler
description: Operations staff member responsible for executing the direct debit cancellation process, including identity verification, mandate confirmation, and customer notification.
context: Upon Cancellation Request: 1. Verify customer identity 2. Confirm mandate details 3. Set mandate status to "Canceled"

name: Automated ARUDD System
description: Automated system responsible for notifying billers of direct debit mandate cancellations using the ARUDD protocol.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Cancellation
description: The direct debit mandate cancellation process with immediate effective date and no notice period required. Includes blocking of pending payments if cancellation occurs before settlement date.
context: Effective Date: Immediate (no notice period required)
Any Pending Payments: Blocked if cancellation before settlement date

name: Customer
description: The customer initiating the direct debit mandate cancellation request. Their identity must be verified and they receive confirmation of the cancellation.
context: Upon Cancellation Request: 1. Verify customer identity

name: Pending Payment Settlement Status Check
description: Decision point determining whether pending payments should be blocked based on whether cancellation occurs before or after the settlement date.
context: Any Pending Payments: Blocked if cancellation before settlement date

name: Biller Cancellation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for handling cancellation requests initiated by a biller. The process involves receipt of the cancellation instruction, system processing, mandate status update, and cessation of further debit processing.

name: Biller Cancellation Instruction Submission
description: The biller formally submits a cancellation instruction to initiate the mandate cancellation workflow.

name: Cancellation Instruction Reception and Processing
description: FirstUK receives the cancellation instruction from the biller and processes it within the system.

name: Mandate Status Update
description: The direct debit mandate status is updated in the system to reflect the cancellation request.

name: Debit Processing Cessation
description: The system is configured to prevent any further debit transactions from being processed against the cancelled mandate.

name: Biller
description: The external party that holds a direct debit mandate and initiates the cancellation request by submitting a cancellation instruction.

name: FirstUK
description: The banking system responsible for receiving, processing, and recording biller cancellation instructions and updating mandate status.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: A direct debit mandate subject to cancellation by the biller. Upon cancellation, the mandate status is updated and no further debits are processed.

name: Account Management During Account Changes
description: End-to-end procedure governing direct debit mandate handling when customers change address, open new accounts, or experience account freezes due to fraud holds. Defines notification requirements, mandate continuity rules, and payment resumption conditions.
context: If Customer Changes Address: Biller notified automatically, Mandate remains active, No interruption to payments
If Customer Gets New Account: Old mandate canceled (if account closed), Customer must authorize new mandate for new account
If Account Frozen (Fraud Hold): Direct Debits blocked temporarily, Biller notified (generic 'unable to process' message), Customer resolution required before payment resumes

name: Address Change Notification to Biller
description: Automatic notification sent to biller when customer changes address. Mandate remains active with no interruption to payments.
context: If Customer Changes Address: Biller notified automatically

name: Old Mandate Cancellation on Account Closure
description: When customer opens a new account and the old account is closed, the direct debit mandate on the old account is automatically canceled.
context: If Customer Gets New Account: Old mandate canceled (if account closed)

name: New Mandate Authorization for New Account
description: Customer must provide explicit authorization for a new direct debit mandate when opening a new account. Biller must receive updated account details.
context: Customer must authorize new mandate for new account
Biller must have new account details

name: Direct Debit Blocking on Fraud Hold
description: Direct debits are temporarily blocked when an account is frozen due to a fraud hold. Biller receives a generic 'unable to process' message.
context: If Account Frozen (Fraud Hold): Direct Debits blocked temporarily

name: Customer Resolution and Payment Resumption
description: Customer must resolve the fraud hold issue before direct debit payments can resume on the frozen account.
context: Customer resolution required before payment resumes

name: Biller
description: External party receiving notifications about mandate changes, account updates, and payment processing status. Receives automatic notifications on address changes and generic messages when payments cannot be processed.
context: Biller must have new account details

name: Customer
description: Account holder responsible for authorizing new mandates when opening new accounts and resolving fraud holds to resume payments.
context: Customer must authorize new mandate for new account
Customer resolution required before payment resumes

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Standing direct debit authorization on customer account. Remains active during address changes, requires cancellation and reauthorization when account changes, and is temporarily blocked during fraud holds.
context: Customer must authorize new mandate for new account

name: Account Fraud Hold
description: Temporary freeze placed on customer account due to suspected fraud. Triggers blocking of direct debits and requires customer resolution before payment processing resumes.
context: Customer resolution required before payment resumes

name: Customer Account
description: Customer's bank account subject to direct debit mandates and account management procedures. Can be closed, frozen, or changed, each triggering specific mandate handling rules.

name: New Account
description: Account opened by customer requiring new direct debit mandate authorization and updated account details to be provided to biller.
context: Customer must authorize new mandate for new account
Biller must have new account details

name: Customer Address Change
description: Update to customer's registered address. Triggers automatic notification to biller while maintaining mandate continuity and uninterrupted payment processing.

name: Quality Assurance Weekly Review
description: A weekly operational review process executed by Operations Staff to monitor Direct Debit processing performance, identify failed collections, customer disputes, and biller complaints. The process includes reconciliation checks to ensure DD transactions match biller instructions, prevent duplicate payments, and investigate failed DDs.

name: Direct Debit Processing Value Check
description: Operations Staff review the total value of Direct Debits processed during the week to monitor transaction volumes and identify anomalies.
context: Total value of Direct Debits processed

name: Failed Collections Monitoring
description: Operations Staff count and review the number of failed collections during the week to identify systemic issues or patterns.

name: Customer Dispute Review
description: Operations Staff review customer disputes received during the week related to Direct Debit transactions.

name: Biller Complaint Review
description: Operations Staff review complaints received from billers during the week regarding Direct Debit processing.

name: Direct Debit Transaction Reconciliation
description: Operations Staff reconcile Direct Debit transactions processed against biller instructions to ensure accuracy and completeness.

name: Duplicate Payment Check
description: Operations Staff verify that no duplicate payments have been processed during the week.

name: Failed Direct Debit Investigation
description: Operations Staff investigate failed Direct Debits to determine root causes and identify corrective actions.

name: Operations Staff
description: The operational team responsible for executing the weekly quality assurance review, including monitoring Direct Debit processing metrics, reconciliation checks, and investigation of failed collections.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct Debit transactions processed and monitored as part of the weekly quality assurance review, including tracking of total values, failed collections, and reconciliation against biller instructions.
context: Total value of Direct Debits processed

name: Mandate and Payment Instruction Recording
description: Mandatory system recording and retention of all direct debit mandates (active and canceled), payment instructions, debit outcomes, customer disputes, and communications. Records must be retained for 6 years per POCA regulations to provide an auditable trail of all mandate lifecycle events and customer interactions.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Direct debit mandates established on customer accounts, including both active mandates in force and canceled mandates. All mandate records are subject to system recording and 6-year retention requirements.

name: Direct Debit Payment Instruction
description: Payment instructions issued under direct debit mandates, including all instructions received by the system. These are recorded and retained as part of the audit trail.

name: Direct Debit Dispute
description: Customer disputes raised against direct debit transactions, including dispute outcomes. All disputes and their resolutions are recorded in the system audit trail and retained for 6 years.

name: Direct Debit Transaction
description: All direct debit transactions processed on customer accounts, including both successful and failed debits. Transaction outcomes are recorded in the system audit trail for compliance and dispute resolution purposes.

name: Customer Communication Record
description: Records of all communications with customers regarding direct debit mandates, payment instructions, and disputes. Communications are retained as part of the audit trail for 6 years per POCA regulations.

name: Standing Order Setup
description: A banking operational process for establishing standing order payment instructions on customer accounts. Referenced as a distinct mechanism separate from direct debit arrangements, governed by dedicated SOPs and system procedures.

name: Direct Debit Setup
description: A banking operational process for establishing direct debit mandates on customer accounts. Defined in the business ontology and distinct from standing order arrangements.

name: Complaint Resolution
description: A banking operational process for handling and resolving customer complaints. Governed by dedicated policy documentation referenced in the related documents.

name: Payment Processing System
description: An automated system responsible for processing payment transactions, including standing orders and direct debits. Supports operational workflows across multiple payment mechanisms.

name: Business Ontology
description: A reference framework defining core banking entities including direct debit arrangements and their operational characteristics.

name: Head of Operations
description: Senior operational leadership role responsible for authoring and approving Standard Operating Procedures. This role has authority over operational policy documentation and process governance.
